free.q: Is the PDF to quiz generator free?
free.a: Yes. Making and playing a quiz from your PDF costs nothing. The number of no-account tries per day is limited, and signing up is free too.

account.a: No. Upload a PDF and play the quiz without signing up or giving an email address.

files.a: PDF files only, up to {pages} pages and {mb} MB. PDFs with selectable text work best; scanned image PDFs are harder to read.

expiry.q: What happens to my quiz after {hours} hours?
expiry.a: If you have not signed up, the quiz and your file are deleted {hours} hours after you make them. Only you can open them until then.

keep.q: How do I keep my quiz?
keep.a: Sign up free from the quiz page within {hours} hours. The quiz is saved to your library, where you can play it again.
